title: AI Generative Full Stack Developer
jobDescription:
AI Generative Full Stack Developer Mode of Work : Hybrid Employment Type: Full-time About the Role We are looking for a talented and passionate AI Generative Full Stack Developer to join our growing engineering team. You will be responsible for designing, building, and deploying intelligent AI-powered applications
- combining cutting-edge generative AI capabilities with robust full stack development using Python and React . You will work at the intersection of AI research and product engineering, turning LLM capabilities into real-world, production-ready features. Key Responsibilities Design and develop AI-powered full stack applications using Python (backend) and React (frontend) Build and maintain agentic frameworks and LLM pipelines using tools like Lang Chain, Llama Index, or custom implementations Integrate generative AI APIs (Open AI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, etc.) into scalable web applications Develop RESTful and Graph QL APIs to connect AI backends with React frontends Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems using vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma DB) Build and optimize prompt engineering workflows and evaluation pipelines Collaborate with product, design, and data science teams to ship AI features end-to-end Write clean, testable, and well-documented code Monitor, debug, and optimize AI model performance in production Stay current with the rapidly evolving generative AI landscape Required Skills & Experience Claude API & Anthropic SDK proficiency
- Hands-on experience with the Messages API, tool use / function calling, system prompt design, and model selection tradeoffs (Sonnet vs. Opus vs. Haiku). Familiarity with context window management and token budgeting. Agentic loop architecture
- Ability to design reliable multi-step agent loops: tool orchestration, retry logic, error recovery, and knowing when to stop or escalate rather than loop indefinitely. Tool/MCP integration
- Experience building and connecting tools (internal APIs, databases, external services) via Anthropic's tool use schema or MCP servers, including input validation and graceful failure handling. Prompt engineering & evaluation
- Skilled at structured prompting (system prompts, few-shot examples, XML tagging), and building prompt eval harnesses to measure output quality, regression-test changes, and tune instructions systematically. Observability & auditability
- Knows how to log full agent traces (inputs, tool calls, intermediate outputs, final responses) in a structured, queryable format. Experience with tools like Lang Smith, Braintrust, Helicone, or custom tracing pipelines. Measurement & KPI design
- Can define and instrument meaningful agent metrics: task completion rate, tool call accuracy, hallucination rate, latency per step, cost per run, and human-in-the-loop escalation rate. Connects agent telemetry to business outcomes. Human-in-the-loop & guardrails
- Understands when to inject human review checkpoints, how to design approval gates for high-stakes actions, and how to implement input/output guardrails (content filtering, schema validation, confidence thresholds). Cost & latency optimization
- Experience profiling and reducing inference costs through prompt caching, batching, streaming, and appropriate model tiering
- without sacrificing reliability. Security & data handling
- Awareness of prompt injection risks, credential/secret hygiene in agentic contexts, PII handling, and least-privilege design when agents have access to real systems or external APIs. Software engineering fundamentals
- Strong async Python (or Type Script), testing discipline (unit + integration tests for agent components), CI/CD, and the ability to decompose complex agent systems into maintainable, modular code. - Foundations (CCA-F) Experience with Claude Code, Cursor, or other AI-assisted development tools Contributions to open-source AI projects Experience with multi-agent frameworks (Auto Gen, Crew AI, Lang Graph) Knowledge of MLOps practices and model deployment (MLflow, Weights & Biases) Familiarity with Web Sockets for real-time AI streaming Experience with Kubernetes or serverless architectures

title: Delivery Director
jobDescription:
Role Overview The Delivery Director is responsible for leading large-scale delivery operations across multiple accounts, ensuring excellence in execution, client satisfaction, profitability, and alignment with the organization’s strategic goals. The role requires a seasoned leader with a strong background in IT services delivery, people management, and stakeholder communication. Key Responsibilities
1. Delivery Management Oversee end-to-end delivery across multiple projects, ensuring adherence to scope, quality, timelines, and budget. Implement robust governance, delivery frameworks, and agile methodologies. Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes and tools.
2. Client Relationship Management Act as the primary escalation point for key clients. Build strong relationships with client executives, ensuring satisfaction and retention. Identify opportunities for account growth and transformation initiatives.
3. Financial & Operational Excellence Own P&L for assigned accounts or business units. Track and report key delivery metrics (margin, utilization, quality, SLA adherence). Optimize resource allocation, cost structures, and operational efficiency.
4. Leadership & People Management Lead, mentor, and develop project delivery managers and teams. Foster a culture of performance, innovation, and collaboration. Drive talent management, succession planning, and capability building.
5. Strategic Initiatives Partner with business and technology leaders to drive digital transformation and automation initiatives. Contribute to pre-sales, RFPs, and solutioning for new engagements. Align delivery practices with organizational growth and client strategy. Key Skills & Competencies Proven track record of managing large delivery portfolios ($10M-$20M+). Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Expertise in Agile / Dev Ops / ITIL frameworks. Excellent problem-solving and decision-making capabilities. Sound understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and delivery governance. Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. 15-25 years of IT services experience with at least 5 years in a senior delivery leadership role. Experience working with global clients (US / Europe) across multiple industries. PMP / PRINCE2 / SAFe certifications preferred. Success Indicators High client satisfaction and contract renewals. Delivery excellence across all accounts. Profitability and margin improvement. Low attrition and high team engagement. Effective adoption of digital delivery tools and frameworks. This is a senior individual contributor role for an analyst who combines technical fluency, strong business judgment, and sharp problem-solving skills. In this role, you will support day-to-day digital analytics needs across website tagging, reporting, analysis, and data-driven personalization and experimentation. You will partner with stakeholders across digital, marketing, content, and optimization to ensure data is reliable, insights are actionable, and measurement supports better business decisions. This role is best suited for someone who is thoughtful, curious, and highly self-directed. We are looking for an analyst who can work through ambiguity, spot issues before they become problems, and make sound decisions without needing step-by-step direction. You should be comfortable asking hard questions of the data, validating your own work, and adapting your approach when the situation does not fit a familiar pattern. Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into clear measurement approaches, reporting structures, and analytical frameworks. Build, maintain, and improve dashboards, recurring reporting, KPI definitions, and insight-driven analyses. Identify trends, performance drivers, risks, and opportunities, then turn findings into clear recommendations. Serve as a strong practitioner in Adobe Analytics, including segmentation, calculated metrics, attribution, workspace analysis, and data interpretation. Review data critically, investigate anomalies, reconcile discrepancies, and catch errors before work is shared. Support day-to-day website tagging operations by helping define requirements, reviewing requests, validating implementation, and strengthening QA and governance processes. Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure digital measurement is aligned with reporting, analysis, and optimization needs. Support personalization and experimentation efforts with audience analysis, measurement planning, test readouts, and insight generation. Help ensure testing and personalization decisions are grounded in a disciplined, data-driven approach. Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to automate repeatable work, improve workflows, and strengthen analytics practices. Support evolving measurement needs tied to organic growth, content performance, and emerging AI-driven traffic sources. Who You Are You are a strong critical thinker who knows how to move from question to analysis to recommendation. You do not stop at producing a report, you look for what is meaningful, what may be wrong, and what action should follow. You can reason through ambiguity and make sound decisions when the answer is not obvious. You catch your own errors and challenge outputs that do not make sense. You are comfortable working independently and do not need highly prescriptive direction to make progress. You communicate clearly and can explain your thinking, assumptions, and conclusions with confidence. You value rigor, accuracy, and strong analytical judgment. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Familiarity with SEO measurement, content performance analysis, and digital growth strategies. Experience in environments that are automating parts of the analytics workflow. Exposure to measuring and interpreting emerging traffic patterns, including AI-driven traffic sources. Experience evaluating or working with analytics tagging QA tools. Power BI experience is preferred. What Success Looks Like In this role, success means more than delivering reports on time. It means producing work that is accurate, well-reasoned, and useful. It means identifying issues early, asking the right questions, and helping the business make better decisions with confidence. It means bringing a high standard of analytical rigor to reporting, tagging, testing, and performance analysis, while continuing to improve how the work gets done. Why Join Us This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in how digital performance is measured and improved. You will work on a broad mix of analytics, measurement, optimization, and experimentation challenges, and you will help shape a more scalable, data-driven approach as our capabilities continue to evolve.
